test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 06 Dec 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
A – B means ‘A is the mother of B’

A % B means ‘A is the brother of B’

A $ B means ‘A is the sister of B’

A @ B means ‘A is the son of B’

If L @ M – N $ O % P, then how is L related to P?
solution:
By using the symbols in the table given below, we can draw the following family tree:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/31358178cf2a5957036a81f6b961d04d7d751d199f015e1e44702b963704c4a5.png] 

Given: 

A – B means ‘A is the mother of B’

A % B means ‘A is the brother of B’

A $ B means ‘A is the sister of B’

A @ B means ‘A is the son of B’

 
 

 Symbol

Find how is L related to P.

Given:- L @ M – N $ O % P

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f7ccf5a0033efccda78bce1a8ae94f73f0ee51ab9cc9b13ad44bf404c915a218.png] 

Clearly, L is the brother of P.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Brother".**
